name: Goo Sphere
body:
GOO SPHERE
CR 2

XP 600
N Medium aberration
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSES

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 20 (3d8+6)
Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +3
Defensive Abilities all-around vision, amorphous; Immune electricity, fire

OFFENSE

Speed fly 20 ft. (good)
Melee slam +5 (1d6 + 4 plus grab)
Special Attacks swallow whole (1d6 + 4, AC 11, 2 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 3, Wis 10, Cha 7
Base Atk +2; CMB +5 (+13 grapple); CMD 16 (20 vs. grapple, can’t be tripped)
Feats Flyby Attack, Power Attack
Skills Fly +9, Perception +5
SQ adhesive

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adhesive (DC 13) (Ex)

A goo sphere exudes a thick tar-like substance that acts as a powerful adhesive, holding fast any creatures or items touching it unless they succeed on a Strength check.

Swallow Whole (Ex)

(1d6 + 4, AC 11, 2 HP)

A goo sphere can swallow creatures of up to Medium-size whole.

ABOUT

Goo spheres are a spherical mass of gelatinous polymer, with an outer surface that is gummy and sticky.
